stage1.title: Welcome
stage1.subtitle: Two minutes to find your way in.
stage1.nameLabel: First, what should we call you?
stage1.namePersist: We'll only keep this on your device.

panels.title: What this is
panels.body: AI Global is built with MIT Professional Education. The mission, in their words: open systems, practical AI, clear stewardship. The tagline: one quarter, one domain, real systems.

panels.title: How a quarter works
panels.body: Each quarter the community focuses on one domain. Q1 2026 is Marketing. GloLabs Vol 1 (Apr 2026) shipped six peer-reviewed case studies — workshop pipelines, multimedia, community growth, content, ambassadors.

panels.title: Why volunteers matter
panels.body: Ambassadors, AI.MRKT teachers, GloLabs authors, contributors — the open-source side of AI Global is people-powered. You're not signing up for anything. You're just looking around.

stage1.ctaHint: It's the warm-up. We'll show you which rock to grab next.
stage1.outcomeWin: 100 m reached. Nice climb. The flow's about to make more sense.
stage1.outcomeFall: Fell off. No score-keeping here — just a feel for the controls.

stage2.title: Your first intro
stage2.subtitle: One line that won't make you cringe.

aboutDiscord.title: About the server
aboutDiscord.body: AI Global runs on Discord. The first stop is #👋introduce-yourself — name, role, country, what you're here for. There's a #🤝onboarding bot that walks you through what's where, and channels for healthcare, finance, ethics, news, and a buddy-finding board.

stage2.categoryPrompt: Pick the lane that feels closest to you. Doesn't have to be perfect.
stage2.ctaHint: Same wall, no training rocks this time.
stage2.outcomeWinBody: That's the climb. Now the intro — copy, head to Discord, paste, and you're in.
stage2.outcomeFallBody: Wall got you. The intro's still ready to go though — copy it, post it, then come back for round two.

stage3.title: The buddy post
stage3.subtitle: There's a #🤝find-a-buddy channel. It expects a specific format. Fill it in.
stage3.introBlurb: Two minutes of forms. The output is one copy-paste-ready Discord post.
stage3.ctaLabel: Climb as high as you can
stage3.ctaHint: No target. Just see how far you get.
stage3.outcomePosterBody: That's the run. Your buddy post is ready — pick a channel to drop it in.

stage4.title: One more game
stage4.subtitle: AI Global also made a tiny one that teaches how a neural net learns.
stage4.body: Six floors: Inputs → Weights → Neurons → Activation → Loss → the learning loop. About ten minutes if you're curious.

stage5.title: Coming soon
stage5.subtitle: Something else lives here. Watch this space.
stage5.body: We're leaving the fifth tile open — a future cohort, a project drop, your own contribution. Check back when the next quarter starts.
